rootfsClean.title: Clean up the system partition
rootfsClean.tool.restart_syslog_ng: Restart DSM’s log service to free deleted logs still in use
rootfsClean.mode.title: Cleanup mode
rootfsClean.mode.standardBody: Keep recent compressed logs and small boot diagnostics. Move eligible leftovers to your chosen folder
rootfsClean.mode.deepBody: Also move KB-listed caches, media log archives and uploaded images, plus recent diagnostic archives. Review each impact below
rootfsClean.mode.confirm: I accept the cache and image impacts and manual follow-up actions; forced rotation may delete old logs
rootfsClean.mode.toolEstimate: Released space cannot be estimated in advance
rootfsClean.impact.update_leftover: Inactive update payloads move and may need downloading again. Boot diagnostic archives move too; retain their copies for support. Active or pending updates stay
rootfsClean.impact.log_archive: Archived history moves to the chosen folder and is no longer available at its original path
rootfsClean.impact.crash_dump: Crash evidence moves to the chosen folder; keep it if support needs it
rootfsClean.impact.temp_debris: Unused named temporary files move; services may recreate temporary files
rootfsClean.toolImpact.rotate_logs: Run DSM log rotation; logs beyond DSM retention may be deleted
rootfsClean.toolImpact.delete_journal: Remove journals belonging to obsolete machine IDs; that history is deleted
rootfsClean.toolImpact.logrotate: Force DSM log rotation even before it is due; the oldest rotations may be deleted and logging may pause
rootfsClean.toolImpact.restart_syslog_ng: Restart logging only if it holds deleted files open; logging pauses briefly
rootfsClean.impact.geoip_database: Location-based firewall rules may need the database downloaded again. Keep the backup and check the rules with support
rootfsClean.impact.preference_image: Uploaded wallpapers and login images move. Users may need to upload and select them again; preference settings stay
rootfsClean.impact.samba_cache: Only the rootfs-local cache moves. Restart Winbind manually afterward; domain access may be interrupted
rootfsClean.toolImpact.clean_downloaded_: Use DSM’s fixed download-clean API. Download the update again before installing it
rootfsClean.toolImpact.release_update_re: Use DSM’s fixed backing-file cleanup on DSM 7.1/7.1.1. Update soon; reboot may recreate the reserve
rootfsClean.keep.unrecognised_image: The resource is not a recognized image; kept
rootfsClean.followUp.refresh_geoip: Check location-based firewall rules. Ask Synology support to download the GeoIP database again before relying on them
rootfsClean.followUp.reset_images: Users may need to upload and select desktop wallpapers or login backgrounds again. Preference settings were kept
rootfsClean.followUp.restart_winbind: Manually restart pkg-synosamba-winbindd on DSM 7 (Samba on DSM 6). Domain access may be interrupted. Reclaim does not restart this service
rootfsClean.followUp.download_update: Download the DSM update again in Control Panel before updating
rootfsClean.followUp.update_dsm: Update DSM and packages soon. A reboot may recreate the reserve; cleanup does not require a reboot. Reclaim will not reboot the NAS
rootfsClean.tool.delete_log: Delete logs older than DSM keeps
rootfsClean.impact.tool_cache: Download caches of tools the administrator installed under /root (such as npm, Bun and pip) move. The tools download what they need again; DSM does not use them
rootfsClean.impact.backup_installer: Hyper Backup’s copy of the DSM installer moves, only while a DSM update would not fit otherwise. Until DSM is updated, Hyper Backup cannot restore the entire system unless you copy it back
rootfsClean.toolImpact.delete_log: Run DSM’s own old-log cleanup, as DSM does before an update. Those logs are deleted; there is no copy
rootfsClean.keep.update_room_enough: A DSM update fits without moving it; kept for Hyper Backup
rootfsClean.followUp.backup_installer: Update DSM now. DSM recreates Hyper Backup’s restore installer after a successful update; until then Hyper Backup cannot restore the entire system unless you copy the moved file back
rootfsClean.destination.scanNote: Files moved here may only appear in the next scan result
